brief:
Francesca Albanese, the UN special rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territories, will participate in a live town hall question-and-answer session with Mehdi Hasan at 4 p.m. ET today, according to Zeteo. The discussion will address audience inquiries regarding developments in Gaza, the West Bank, and broader issues related to Palestinian rights and the occupation.

Albanese has gained prominence for her direct statements on Israeli policies and their impact on Palestinians. The special rapporteur, an independent UN expert mandate holder, investigates human rights concerns in occupied Palestinian territory. Zeteo is encouraging interested viewers to register ahead of the event to submit questions for the live broadcast.
dek: The outspoken UN special rapporteur on occupied Palestine will take YOUR questions on Gaza, the West Bank, and more in this can’t miss Zeteo Town Hall. Sign up now!.
title: UN rapporteur Albanese to answer audience questions on Gaza live
